scope: Explicitly reviewed project encoder dependencies and numerical controls. No external paper payload, solver binary or campaign launcher.

files.lineage: Project middle-band pin generator; historical source retained unchanged.
Project characteristic profiler; embedded pin39b is an external published numerical control, not a project novelty claim. The bundle tests the two separately attributed JSON seeds, not that preset.
Project encoder; byte-identical to the already distributed guided/minsup/sha_cnf.py. Its totalizer credits Bailleux-Boufkhad 2003; that algorithmic credit is retained.
Project plain-Python compression rechecker; no encoder import. Its success marker, not its exit status alone, determines whether a pair passed.
Project P8 FOUND_s102 numerical seed; lineage recorded in boardpairs/setup_seeds.py. That operational setup script is not included.
External numerical control credited by setup_seeds.py to Table 17 of ePrint 2026/1120. Reference https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1120 ; no paper text or PDF is included.
